name: draw-and-play
description: Web-based tournament software with planner, live forecast and browser-based result entry

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@draw-and-play/server & npm run dev --workspace=@draw-and-play/web & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@draw-and-play/web && npm run build --workspace=@draw-and-play/server
scripts.e2e: docker run --rm --network host --ipc host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -e BASE -e ADMIN_PASSWORD -v "$PWD":/repo -w /repo mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble node e2e/walkthrough.mjs
scripts.demo: docker compose -p draw-and-play-demo --env-file docker/demo.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.demo.yml up -d --build
scripts.demo:down: docker compose -p draw-and-play-demo --env-file docker/demo.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.demo.yml down
scripts.demo:reset: docker compose -p draw-and-play-demo --env-file docker/demo.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.demo.yml down -v && npm run demo
